chunks.sanskrit: ni̠rva̠ru̠ṇa̠tvāya̍ vāru̠ṇaḥ atho̠ ya e̠va kaśca̠ santhsū̠yate̎|
tau ya̠dā sa̠gaṃcche̍te atha̍ vī̠ryā̍vattaro bhavati||
tāsā̠g̠ͫ sarvā̍sāgͫ sūyate ya e̠tena̠ yaja̍te|
anu̍ddhate̠ vedyai̍ dakhṣiṇa̠ta ā̍hava̠nīya̍sya bṛha̠taḥ sto̠traṃ pratya̠bhiṣi̍ñcati|
tviṣi̠raśve̍ṣu̠ puru̍ṣeṣu̠ goṣu̍ indra̠ym̐yā de̠vī su̠bhagā̍ ja̠jāna̍|
indrā̍ya̠ tvauja̍svata̠ oja̍svantagͫͫ śrīṇāmi indrā̍ya tvā̠ paya̍svate̠ paya̍svantagͫͫ śrīṇāmi|
tat te̠ praya̍cchāmi oja̍svadastu me̠ mukha̎m|
sūrya̍ iva̠ jyoti̍ṣā vi̠bhūḥ a̠pāym̐yo drava̍ṇe̠ rasaḥ̍|
a̠ṅkaunya̠ṅkā va̠bhito̠ ratha̠ym̐yau dhvā̠ntavm̐vā̍tā̠gramanu̍ sa̠caṃra̍ntau dū̠re he̍tirindri̠yāvā̎n pata̠trī te no̠'gnayaḥ̠ papra̍yaḥ pārayantu||
(ālso same appearing above, in ṭbh.2.7.16.1 ) āti̍ṣṭha vṛtraha̠nratha̎m ||
anu̠ tvendro̍ mada̠tvanu̠ bṛha̠spatiḥ̍ anu̠ somo̠ anva̠gnirā̍vīt|
tasmā̍de̠ta ai̎ndrā māru̠tā u̠khṣāṇaḥ̍ sava̠nīyā̍ bhavanti|
ya e̠tena̠ yaja̍te ya u̍ cainame̠vavm̐veda̍||
e̠tena̠ vai ma̠ruto̍ de̠vānāṃ̠ bhūyi̍ṣṭhā abhavann|
ṛ̠tunā̍ yajñavāhasā dve virū̍pe carataḥ̠ svarthe̎|
ā tve̠ṣamu̠gramava̍ īmahe va̠yam te svā̠nino̍ ru̠driyā̍ va̠ra̠ṣani̍rṇijaḥ|
tve a̍gne suma̠tiṃ bhikhṣa̍māṇāḥ di̠vi śravo̍ dadhire ya̠jñiyā̍saḥ|
tiṣṭhā̠ harī̠ ratha̠ ā yu̠jyamā̍nā yā̠hi|
agre̍ vi̠khṣu pratīda̍yat bhare̠ṣvindra̍gͫ su̠hava̍gͫ havāmahe|
suva̍rva̠jjyoti̠rabha̍yagͫͫ sva̠sti ṛ̠ṣvā ta̍ indra̠ sthavi̍rasya bā̠hū|
tāste̍ vajrin dhe̠navo̍ jojayurnaḥ gabha̍stayo ni̠yuto̍ vi̠śvavā̍rāḥ|
i̠māṃ te̠ dhiyaṃ̠ prabha̍re ma̠ho ma̠hīm|
sa bhū̠tānā̠madhi̍patirbabhūva tasya̍ mṛ̠tyau ca̍rati rāja̠sūya̎m|
tene̠mama̍gna i̠ha varca̍sā̠ sama̍ṅgdhi ā'yaṃ bhā̍tu̠ śava̍sā̠ pañca̍ kṛ̠ṣṭīḥ|
yathā''sā̍ rāṣṭra̠varddha̍naḥ tathā̎ tvā savi̠tā ka̍rat|
bṛha̠spati̍stvo̠pari̍ṣṭāda̠bhiṣi̍ñcatu̠ pāṅkte̍na̠ chanda̍sā a̠ru̠ṇaṃ tvā̠ vṛka̍mu̠graṃ kha̍jaṃ ka̠ram|
avya̍thāyai (avya̍dhāyai) tvā sva̠dhāyai̎ tvā mā na̍ indrā̠bhita̠stvadṛ̠ṣvāri̍ṣṭāsaḥ|
anu̠ tvendro̍ mada̠ {31]. tvanu̍ tvā mi̠trāvaru̍ṇau ||
anu̍ tvā'vatu savi̠tā sa̠vena̍ indra̠vm̐viśvā̍ avīvṛdhann|
tanmā̠tā pṛ̍thi̠vī tat pi̠tā dyauḥ tadgrāvā̍ṇaḥ soma̠suto̍ mayo̠bhuvaḥ̍|
ava̍ te̠ heḍo̍ varuṇa̠ namo̍bhi̠rava̍ ya̠jñebhi̍rīmahe ha̠virbhiḥ̍|
athā̍ va̠yamā̍ditya vra̠te tavā'nā̍gaso̠ adi̍taye syāma||
avā̎srāgdī̠khṣā va̠śinī̠ hyu̍grā de̠hi dakhṣi̍ṇāṃ̠ prati̍ra̠svāyuḥ̍|
sa̠vi̠tā varca̠ āda̍dhāt tebhyo̍ ni̠dhānaṃ̍ bahu̠dhā vyaiccha̍nn|
ya u̍ cainame̠vavm̐veda̍ yagͫ rājā̍na̠vm̐viśo̠ nāpa̠cāye̍yuḥ|
yo vā̎ brāhma̠ṇastama̍sā pā̠pmanā̠ prāvṛ̍taḥ̠ syāt|
yada̍smai̠ svā viśo̍ ba̠ligͫ hara̍nti hara̍ntyasmai̠ viśo̍ ba̠lim|
ā śreya̍so̠ bhrātṛ̍vyasya̠ teja̍ indri̠yaṃ da̍tte|
ya u̍ cainame̠vavm̐veda̍ tad yathā̍ ha̠ vai sa̍cā̠kriṇau̠ kapla̍kāvu̠pāva̍hitau̠ syātā̎m|
teṣva̠sāvā̍di̠tyo bṛ̍ha̠tīra̠bhyū̍ḍhaḥ sa̠tobṛ̍hatīṣu stuvate sa̠to bṛ̍hann|
